# 🧭 Browse by Facet

Every page is filed once by topic in the sidebar. **Facets** are the cross-cutting way in.

!!! success "What changed vs GitBook"
    These listings are **generated at build time** from each page's frontmatter
    tags, which were themselves lifted from the `**Facets:**` footers the vault
    already had. There is no hand-written page count that can drift, and no
    per-facet table to append a row to. Adding a tag to a page is the whole edit.
